_README: The protocol: every run is `dgr run <experiment> --yes`, which exports exactly the parameters recorded here (backend = model, client, reasoning effort, temperature, max tokens, prompt budget; env = the condition). The endpoint and key come from the environment or .env. Experiment names are <split>_<condition>; results land in results/reference/<model>/<condition>/ (a condition directory holds both splits, the question ids differ).

deepseek-azure._note: The reference model: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 on Azure AI Foundry through the stdlib client (llm.py), reasoning effort low, temperature 0, prompt budget 240k tokens counted with the model's own tokenizer (LLM_TOKENIZER, pinned; a run refuses to start if it cannot be loaded). Set AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT and AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY in .env. To run another model, add a backend with the same keys (LLM_CLIENT=litellm reaches any litellm provider).
